vocabulary.definition: relating to or using nuclear reactions that occur only at very high temperatures
vocabulary.example: The country tested a new thermonuclear weapon in the desert.

vocabulary.example: Nuclear power plants use controlled fission reactions to generate electricity.

vocabulary.definition: a state of matter similar to a gas but consisting of positively and negatively charged particles
vocabulary.example: The sun is made up of hot plasma.
